resources.title: Comparative analysis
resources.text: Compare the arguments in two assigned readings. Cite both sources. Submit a 900-word essay. AI may explain concepts and ask questions, but must not write the submission.

policy.evidence: AI may explain concepts and ask questions, but must not write the submission.

resources.title: Argument and evidence
resources.text: A claim states a position. Evidence supports it. A warrant explains why the evidence supports the claim.

policy.evidence: Use AI for explanations, not submitted work.
